content.en: Algorithms are being used to improve the diagnosis and prediction of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and other neurodegenerative disorders. These algorithms can identify novel biomarkers in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that can distinguish AD from other disorders, as well as combinations of biomarkers that enhance diagnostic accuracy. They can also integrate core CSF biomarkers into new diagnostic algorithms and predict the development of dementia in pre-dementia subjects. Overall, algorithms are helping researchers and clinicians better understand and diagnose AD.
content.da: Algoritmer bruges til at forbedre diagnosen og forudsigelsen af Alzheimers sygdom (AD) og andre neurodegenerative lidelser. Disse algoritmer kan identificere nye biomarkører i cerebrospinalvæske (CSF), der kan skelne AD fra andre lidelser, samt kombinationer af biomarkører, der forbedrer den diagnostiske nøjagtighed. De kan også integrere centrale CSF-biomarkører i nye diagnostiske algoritmer og forudsige udviklingen af demens hos præ-dementi personer. Samlet set hjælper algoritmer forskere og klinikere med bedre at forstå og diagnosticere AD.

critic.en: Biomarker algorithms for neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's? That's a potential Pandora's box! If these algorithms are just used for diagnosing people, I wonder how long it will take before they're applied to screen job applicants or even used in insurance policies? Just last week, a researcher at a conference made the audacious claim that AI-driven diagnostics could soon become a prerequisite for certain high-level positions to assess candidates' long-term cognitive health. What will you do if your potential employer asks for an "AI-certified" cognitive health report?
critic.da: Vi skaber algoritmer, der hjælper med at identificere og forudsige alvorlige sygdomme. Men hvad sker der egentlig med vores data? Og hvem har kontrollen?

potential.en: That's so fascinating! I believe the potential of technology in healthcare is immense. By using advanced algorithms, we can not only improve the accuracy of early diagnosis but also provide personalized treatment strategies for patients. AD is a devastating disease, and the work being done to harness the power of technology to combat it is truly inspiring.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan algoritmer kan revolutionere diagnosen af neurodegenerative sygdomme som Alzheimers. Denne teknologi kan virkelig gøre en forskel for patienter og deres familier ved at tilbyde tidligere og mere præcise diagnoser. Hvor stor tror I, at indflydelsen fra disse algoritmer kan blive i det kliniske arbejde i de kommende år?
